fact: The driver of Car 4 made several manoeuvres in the final lap of the race which were reported by the Race Director to the Stewards.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 33.4 of the Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. There did not appear to be any significant changes of direction under braking, and the move at Turn 15 was a legitimate defending move by the driver of Car 4. In Turn 1 Car 4 locked up under braking and went wide, losing a position. Accordingly the Stewards determine that there is no erratic driving and hence take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 4 Alleged Driving Erratically
to: The Team Manager, McLaren Formula 1 Team
